title: Get + 受詞 + to-infinitive
titleEn: Using Get + object + to-infinitive to cause or persuade

source.file: Sentence Structure 172 -「Get + 受詞 + to-infinitive」促成句.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Subject + get + object + to + base verb + other information

formulas.formula: Subject + get + object + to + base verb + other information

rules.zh: 受詞是執行動作的人或事物 （老師讓學生練習。） 實際進行練習的是 the students，不是 the teacher。
rules.en: The object is the person or thing that performs the action. In The teacher got the students to practise, the students—not the teacher—do the practising.
examples: The teacher got the students to practise.

rules.zh: Get 必須按照時態改變 （我通常會叫弟弟幫助我。） （我昨天叫弟弟幫助我。） （我明天會叫弟弟幫助我。）
rules.en: Change get to match the tense: get/gets in the present, got in the past, will get in the future, can/should/could get after a modal, and forms such as is trying to get in a continuous construction.
examples: Modal verb：can get / should get / could get
I usually get my brother to help me.
I got my brother to help me yesterday.
I will get my brother to help me tomorrow.

rules.zh: To 後面使用動詞原形 在這個句型中，to 不可以省略。
rules.en: Use the base form after to, and do not omit to in this pattern: She got him to apologise, not She got him to apologised or She got him apologise.

rules.zh: 人稱代名詞必須使用受詞形式 （老師讓我們留下來。）
rules.en: Use the object form of a personal pronoun: me, him, her, us or them. Write The teacher got us to stay behind, not got we to stay behind.
examples: The teacher got us to stay behind.
The teacher got we to stay behind.

rules.zh: 否定形式 （教練說服球員不要太早復操。） 否定的是受詞所做的動作，而不是 get。
rules.en: For a negative action, use get + object + not to + base verb, as in The coach got the player not to return too soon. The negative applies to the action performed by the object, not to get.
examples: Subject + get + object + not to + base verb
The coach got the player not to return too soon.

rules.zh: Get someone to do 與 make someone do 不同 Get + object + to + verb 通常表示說服、鼓勵、安排或設法促成某件事。 （她說服他道歉。） Make + object + verb 通常帶有較強的強迫意味，而且不使用 to。 （她迫使他道歉。）
rules.en: Get someone to do differs from make someone do. Get + object + to + verb normally means persuade, encourage, arrange or manage to bring about an action: She got him to apologise. Make + object + verb has a stronger sense of compulsion and takes no to: She made him apologise.

rules.zh: 不要與 get to + verb 混淆 本課目標句型 （老師說服學生參加旅行。） 在 get 和 to 之間有受詞 the students。 另一個不同句型 （學生可能有機會享受一次長洲之旅。） 這裏的 get to enjoy 表示「有機會享受」或「得以享受」。get 和 to 之間沒有受詞，因此不屬於本課 的目標句型。
rules.en: Do not confuse get + object + to + verb with get to + verb. In The teacher got the students to join the trip, the object the students appears between get and to, so this is the target causative pattern. In The students may get to enjoy a trip to Cheung Chau, get to enjoy means “have the opportunity to enjoy”; there is no object between get and to, so it is a different structure.
examples: The teacher got the students to join the trip.

benefits.zh: 清楚表示「誰促使誰做甚麼」 這個句型能清楚交代促成事情的人，以及實際執行動作的人。 （經理安排員工出席會議。） 讀者可以立即看出：經理負責促成事情，而員工負責出席。
benefits.en: It clearly identifies who causes an action and who actually performs it. In The manager got the staff to attend the meeting, the manager brings the action about and the staff do the attending.
examples: The manager got the staff to attend the meeting.

benefits.zh: 表示行動成功產生了結果 Ask someone to do something 只表示提出要求，不一定代表對方真的照做。 （她要求他道歉。） Get someone to do something 通常表示她成功令對方採取行動。 （她成功說服他道歉。）
benefits.en: It shows that a request or attempt successfully produced the intended action. Ask someone to do something only reports a request and does not prove compliance: She asked him to apologise. Get someone to do something normally shows that the persuasion succeeded: She got him to apologise.

benefits.zh: 適合表達說服、合作和解決問題 日常生活中，我們經常需要別人幫忙、改變決定或完成工作。這個句型可以用來描述這些實際情 況。 因此，它很適合用於日常對話、學校、工作和顧客服務情境。
benefits.en: It is useful for describing persuasion, cooperation, practical help and problem-solving in daily life, school, work and customer service.
examples: get a customer to try something
get a company to give a refund
get a landlord to repair something

benefits.zh: 可以代替較長的解釋 （我與湯姆談了幾次。最後，他同意加入我們的團隊。） （我成功說服湯姆加入我們的團隊。） 這個句型能把「提出要求、進行說服和成功產生結果」濃縮在一個完整句子中。
benefits.en: It can replace a longer explanation. I spoke to Tom several times. Finally, he agreed to join our team becomes I got Tom to join our team. The structure compresses the request, persuasion and successful result into one complete sentence.
examples: I spoke to Tom several times. Finally, he agreed to join our team.
I got Tom to join our team.

benefits.zh: 不只可以用於人，也可以用於物件 這個句型亦可以表示設法令機器或物件正常運作。 （技術員令打印機重新運作。） 這種用法在描述科技問題、維修和日常困難時非常實用。
benefits.en: It can refer not only to people but also to making a machine or object work: The technician got the printer to work again. This use is especially useful for technology problems, repairs and everyday difficulties.
examples: The technician got the printer to work again.
